text.tspan: In a pod (ndots:5), one lookup of google.com sends 4 questions
Pod /etc/resolv.conf: search default.svc.cluster.local svc.cluster.local cluster.local · options ndots:5
Fewer than 5 dots in the name → try every search domain FIRST
On a Mac with no search
4 questions, 3 wasted · ×2 for A and AAAA
on every external call → slow calls, busy CoreDNS
lower ndots via dnsConfig · NodeLocal DNSCache
